name: JSON Formatter
description: Format, minify and validate JSON in your browser, with exact large numbers, sorted keys and the line and column of the first error.
facts: Formats JSON with 2 spaces, 4 spaces or a tab, and can minify it or only validate it
Reports the line and column of the first error and moves the cursor to that spot
Keeps numbers exactly as written, for example 12345678901234567890, because numbers are read as text and never rounded
Follows the JSON standard strictly: trailing commas, comments, single quotes and NaN are reported as errors
Can sort object keys from A to Z and warns when an object repeats a key
Shows the size before and after, the number of keys and the nesting depth
Runs entirely in the browser; the text is never uploaded or stored
limits: Very large documents can be slow on older phones because all work happens on your device
Only the first error is reported, so fix it and run the check again
Sorted keys use plain A to Z order of the key text
use_cases: shrinking JSON before pasting it into a URL
comparing two versions of a file
